name: Advent Together
intro: This test is for the weeks BEFORE December 1, while the 24 doors are still locked. You will add a made-up family, try the Day 1 sample, set up the church kit with an example church name, and use Preview mode to read a door ahead of time.

steps.do: Look at the welcome card at the bottom (“Welcome to Advent Together”). Tap the small words “skip the tour” at its bottom right.
steps.see: A card asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may also show at the top (for example “Good morning.”). Tap its ✕ if it is in the way.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.see: A small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” with OK and Cancel.

steps.do: Tap “OK”.
steps.see: Near the top: “ADVENT 2026 — Advent begins Sunday, November 29”, a big number of days to go, and a “👀 Try the Day 1 sample” button. Further down, “The 24 doors” each show a 🔒.

steps.do: Scroll down to “The 24 doors” and tap door 5 (it says 🔒 5 Sat).
steps.see: It stays locked. A short note says “Door 5 opens on Saturday, December 5. Try the Day 1 sample at the top.”

steps.do: Scroll down to “Our family”, tap the box under “Who’s doing Advent together?” and type these example names.
steps.see: The names are in the box, with the apostrophe in O'Brien looking right. Under it: 0 stars of 24 and 0 days in a row.

steps.do: Scroll back to the top and tap “👀 Try the Day 1 sample”.
steps.see: A panel opens: “DAY 1 OF 24 · TUESDAY, DECEMBER 1” and “💡 A great light”, a gold note starting “👀 Sample”, the line “With Grandma O'Brien, Emma and Noah”, and the verse from Isaiah 9:2 (KJV).

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom of the panel and tap “We did it ✓”.
steps.see: A short note says “That is how it works. From December 1, this gives your family a star.” No star is added.
steps.tip: The “🔊 Read it aloud” and “📤 Share” buttons sit under the purple test-copy bar here; you don’t need them for this test.

steps.do: Scroll back up in the panel and tap the ✕ at its top right.
steps.see: The panel closes. “Our family” still says 0 stars of 24.

steps.do: Scroll down to “For churches” and tap “⛪ Open the church kit”.
steps.see: A “⛪ Church kit” panel opens: “Everything a church needs to invite the whole congregation. Nothing here is sent anywhere.” with a box for your church’s name.

steps.do: Tap the church name box and type this example name.
steps.see: The insert below changes right away: it now starts “St. Mary's Church (example) walks to Christmas together.”

steps.do: Scroll down in the panel and tap “🖨️ Print the insert”.
steps.see: A print preview opens: one page headed “🕯️ Advent Together” with your church’s name, the Sunday candles, and a list of all 24 days with a verse and one small thing to do. Tap Cancel.

steps.do: Scroll further down and tap “📋 Copy the announcement”.
steps.see: A short note says “Announcement copied.” (You don’t need to paste it anywhere.)

steps.do: Scroll back to the top of the church kit and tap its ✕.
steps.see: The church kit closes and you are back on the main page.

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom and tap “⚙️ Settings”.
steps.see: It opens with three choices: “Bigger type”, “Preview mode” and a “Clear our stars and start over” button.

steps.do: Tap “Preview mode”.
steps.see: Its switch turns on, a short note says “Preview mode on: every door is open.”, and the 🔒 locks are gone from the 24 doors.

steps.do: Scroll up to “The 24 doors” and tap door 5 (5 Sat).
steps.see: It opens now: “DAY 5 OF 24 · SATURDAY, DECEMBER 5”, “🏘️ Little Bethlehem”, a note starting “👁 Preview”, “With Grandma O'Brien, Emma and Noah”, and the verse from Micah 5:2.

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom of the panel and tap “We did it ✓”.
steps.see: No star yet — a short note says “You can tick this one on Saturday, December 5.” Then scroll up and tap ✕ to close the panel.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap door 12 (12 Sat).
steps.see: It still opens with no internet: “DAY 12 OF 24 · SATURDAY, DECEMBER 12” with its reading. Tap ✕ to close it.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Your family names are still under “Our family” and the doors are still open (Preview mode stayed on). A card “Keep Advent Together on your Home Screen” may slide up — tap “Later”.

steps.do: Tap “⚙️ Settings” at the bottom (if it is closed) and tap “Preview mode” again to turn it off.
steps.see: The 🔒 locks come back on all 24 doors — they will open one by one from December 1.
